summary: Source-anchored research for rawData bucket-level CRUD (8.2 and later). Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: For MongoDB 8.2 and later, the Atlas Online Archive cleanup procedure deletes marked buckets with a delete command on the time-series collection and rawData:true, filtering control.closed:true and control.max.<timeField> at or before a cutoff. It requires confirming a backup or archived copy and checking the filter because the operation permanently deletes the matched data. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The server query README labels single-namespace, viewless time-series collections as 9.0+. In that model system.buckets.<collection> does not exist, and raw bucket queries target the user namespace with rawData: true. Do not infer that every 8.2 deployment already lacks the bucket namespace merely because rawData starts in 8.2. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Raw bucket CRUD support does not imply rawData support for sharding DDL. SERVER-121850 records moveChunk, split, mergeChunks, moveRange, clearJumboFlag, cleanupOrphaned and mergeAllChunksOnShard as still legitimately targeting system.buckets, with broader support tracked separately in SERVER-119235. This is a March 2026 limitation record, not a verified October support matrix. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-25)

rawData: true lets CRUD commands operate on stored bucket documents through the time-series collection namespace, bypassing logical measurement translation. For example, db.runCommand({find: "coll", rawData: true}) reads buckets rather than unpacked measurements. (high confidence)

The vendor-derived SERVER-121886 record describes dbAdmin missing performRawDataOperations despite having index actions. Its March 27, 2026 snapshot lists 8.2.0 and 8.3.0-alpha1 as affected and 9.0.0-rc0 and 8.3.0-rc4 as fixed; verify the exact deployed patch rather than assuming dbAdmin suffices. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-27)

The driver specifications introduce rawData at MongoDB 8.2 and prohibit sending it to pre-8.2 servers; the Node driver implementation ticket additionally gates transmission on server wire version >=27. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-09-11)

MongoDB driver specifications classify rawData as internal to MongoDB teams, discourage general application use, and warn that it may change or disappear in any release without notice; driver support is optional and should discourage customer use. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-09-09)

The Node driver bucket-access ticket covers aggregate, bulkWrite, count, delete, distinct, find, findAndModify, insert and update, as well as index and collection metadata commands; these are raw-access surfaces, not a dedicated bucket-merging command. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-09-11)

The server implementation requires writers that update bucket documents outside BucketCatalog to notify it through timeseries::handleDirectWrite or BucketCatalog::clear to avoid corrupting bucket state. This is a server-internal invariant, not an application-side API or a standalone bucket-merging recipe. (low confidence)

Research inference: rawData access alone does not establish that copying or editing bucket documents will consolidate fragmented buckets. The implementation describes direct access, while the driver contract discourages application use; neither supplies a verified fragmentation-remediation merge algorithm. (medium confidence)

MongoDB driver specifications introduce rawData with server 8.2 and forbid sending it to pre-8.2 servers. The Node driver acceptance criteria additionally gate forwarding on rawData being true and server wire version being at least 27. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

The driver work enumerates rawData support for find, aggregate, count, distinct, insert, update, delete, findAndModify and bulkWrite, plus index and collection-listing operations. Availability of an ordinary driver method alone does not establish that its public options expose rawData. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Atlas documents a specific bucket-delete procedure: before 8.2 target system.buckets.<collection>; on 8.2 and later send the delete command to the time-series collection with rawData: true. Its filter uses bucket fields such as control.closed and control.max.<timeField>, not measurement-level predicates. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

For buckets marked closed by Online Archive, ordinary measurement updates and deletes ignore the bucket and deletes can report deletedCount: 0. Atlas prescribes direct bucket deletion for that case and warns to verify the filter and an existing backup or archived copy before permanent deletion. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Database Tools 100.16.0, released April 1, 2026, added rawData CRUD API support to the database tools. Its release notes say mongoexport against 8.3 no longer exports system.buckets namespaces, and authenticated mongodump against 8.3 additionally requires performRawDataOperations, included in backup. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-01)
